notes.title: Game Released!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Rise of Transport is finally live![/b]
It’s been a long road to reach this point. As a solo developer taking on the work of a full team, this is without a doubt one of the most important moments of my career. But this is only the beginning.[/p][p][b]Rise of Transport[/b] is just the tip of the iceberg of an open-world, physics-based simulation and RPG framework that I’ve been developing for almost 10 years out of my passion for simulations. Now it’s time to put my work out there![/p][p]What matters most to me now is hearing your feedback. When you’re multitasking in every direction, it’s easy to lose objectivity about the results. My first priority will be to track down issues, polish what’s already in the game, and ensure the network experience is rewarding.[/p][p]As an [b]early access indie simulation[/b], please keep in mind there will be rough edges. But for those willing to embrace the glitches in the matrix, there will be a [b]“Release Week Event”[/b] with [b]x2 earnings during the first week! [/b]and [b]10% off[/b] during the first 30 days.![/p]

notes.title: Steam Friends & DEMO!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! 

I'm excited to announce that Steam Matchmaking has been successfully integrated into the game! In this initial version, only Steam Friends will appear in the lobby list. After release, I plan to add server rules, allowing hosts to customize networking settings and enable public servers. Also, I will be releasing the DEMO version later today. This demo is a simplified version of the game, set on a demo island that does not exist in the full game. You can test the initial vehicles and horses both in single and multiplayer.

Full game release date is still holding for the 1st of SEP.  as tests and bug hunting continues!

Cheers![/p]
